source.title: Astoundingly Awesome Tales Issue #3 — Showdown in Skull Canyon
source.pagination: PDF/source pages 1–3 are unnumbered front matter; PDF/source pages 4–23 match printed pages 4–23.

authority.rule: Use collection mechanical differences only when already approved in the project; otherwise record the divergence without silently normalizing.

method: PDF source -> expected inventory -> repository -> canonical -> EN -> FR -> tests

pageReview.notes: Cover only.
Credits and legal text only.
Contents only.
Adventure synopsis only.
Adventure hooks and quest-level guidance only.
Encounter prose; .44 Pistol and Assault Rifle are references to existing identities, not complete profiles.
Narrative NPCs and vendor setup; Strobe Beacon is named but lacks reusable mechanics.
Complete Wastelander profile. It differs from the Core identity and from the later collection profile, so it is retained as a distinct Issue #3 variant.
Biogel verified. Epoxy is corrected per the owner-approved authoritative 2024 collection: Repair difficulty -1 to a minimum of 0.
Issue #3 consumables verified. Skull Canyon Shot follows the owner-approved 2024 correction and no longer has Lasting; six Core consumables remain identical reprints using existing identities.
Meeting Xarn is narrative scenario material; no complete reusable profile.

Twinjaw Rattler corrected to the owner-approved 2024 collected mechanics: Major-action Twin Heads with split targets, once-per-battle Death Rattle affecting all attacks for the turn, Mutant Rattler Meat butchery, and no poison-sack branch. Foundry body type is quadruped.

Named Ranger personalities plus optional tactical modifiers to the NCR Trooper baseline. These are scenario-specific optional modifications, not autonomous complete reusable profiles; no separate Actor identities created.
NCR Trooper corrected to the owner-approved 2024 collected profile: LUC 3 and 12+4 DC 10mm Rounds in Inventory; embedded attacks execute the printed STR/AGI + skill tests.
NCR information and investigation clues only; Brown and Aurelius are narrative references without autonomous complete profiles on this page.

Uncovering the Secret is investigation and location prose. The homing beacon, alien tool, papers and power-cell factory are not given complete reusable profiles; no new canonical/EN/FR document is warranted.

Aliens Unveiled and Decisions, Decisions provide narrative NPC reactions and hospital/technology descriptions only. Vexx, Zara’el, Xarn, Sally Jessup and Sarah Miller do not receive complete reusable profiles on this page.
Act Two synopsis only; it previews conflicts, NPCs and a Zetan laboratory but defines no autonomous reusable structured document.

Awash with Conflict reuses the already-certified Twinjaw Rattler encounter identity from p.12 plus previously established NCR/Wastelander references; no new stat block, embedded Item, salvage or butchery data appears, so no duplicate identity or provenance change is created.

The Lone Wolf and Investigating the Rangers’ Motivation are scenario prose. Corporal Brown has no complete reusable profile; the security drones are encounter references whose complete profile first appears on p.21.

Security Drone, Protectron corrected to the owner-approved 2024 collected profile: Energy DR 3 (All), BODY + Guns Arm Lasers, robot body type/origin, and complete salvage procedure retained in text plus structured material fields.

The owner-approved 2024 collection replaces the individual issue's Super Mutant with the Abomination profile. The Abomination is authoritative; the 2023 Super Mutant identity is retained only as a historical source variant.
Secret Manipulation is scenario narrative. Private Mark Aurelius is referenced but receives no autonomous complete reusable profile on this page.
Act Three synopsis and Choosing Sides are scenario narrative only; no autonomous reusable structured document is defined.

The Battle of Skull Canyon and Encounter 3A define an Extended Test and encounter composition. They reference existing NCR, Protectron and Twinjaw identities, while the Inertia Suppression Field is only named here and receives its complete reusable profile on p.26.

Skull Canyon Zetan corrected to the owner-approved 2024 collection: Mutated Alien and 38 XP while retaining the same attacks/inventory. Xarn/Nok Mighty +2 Mind guidance is scenario-specific incomplete variant guidance. Inertia Suppression Field remains mechanically identical and its FR/provenance metadata is cleaned.
The owner-approved 2024 collection's reinforcement scaling is recorded as scenario procedure, and its complete Mercenary-derived Sally Jessup profile is integrated as a bilingual Actor.

Conclusion, Fallout and Quest Rewards contain scenario-resolution outcomes, Caps/XP rewards, access/discount consequences and future hooks, but no autonomous reusable Actor, Item or genuinely random RollTable. No canonical/EN/FR document is created.

candidates.name: Wastelander (AAT #3)
candidates.note: Individual p.8 prints Carry Weight 200 lb, Melee Weapons 2 and Energy Weapons 1, and omits ammunition from Inventory. A distinct identity prevents collapsing it into the Core Wastelander.

candidates.name: Epoxy
candidates.note: The 2024 collected edition is owner-approved as authoritative: Repair difficulty is reduced by 1 to a minimum of 0.

candidates.name: Skull Canyon Shot
candidates.note: The 2024 collected edition is owner-approved as authoritative: the +3 Radiation damage resistance no longer has Lasting.

candidates.name: Twinjaw Rattler
candidates.note: The 2024 collected edition is owner-approved as authoritative: Twin Heads is tied to a Major attack action and may split targets, Death Rattle is once per battle and affects all attacks until end of turn, and the poison-sack butchery branch is removed. Foundry body type is modeled as quadruped, the closest available non-humanoid hit-location family for a giant snake.

candidates.name: NCR Trooper
candidates.note: The 2024 collected edition is owner-approved as authoritative: LUC 3 and 12+4 DC 10mm Rounds in Inventory. Canonical origin and embedded provenance were cleaned.

candidates.name: Security Drone, Protectron
candidates.note: The 2024 collected edition is owner-approved as authoritative: Energy DR 3 (All). Full salvage procedure is preserved in localized biography text alongside structured difficulty/material fields.

candidates.name: Super Mutant (AAT #3)
candidates.note: Historical 2023 source profile retained under its published identity for source fidelity, but superseded for current Issue #3 mechanics by the authoritative 2024 Abomination profile (3db5227b46e039ec).

candidates.name: Skull Canyon Zetan
candidates.note: The 2024 collected edition is owner-approved as authoritative: Mutated Alien, 38 XP. Xarn/Nok Mighty +2 Mind guidance remains scenario-specific incomplete variant guidance and does not create autonomous Actors.

candidates.name: Inertia Suppression Field
candidates.note: Mechanics are identical in 2023/2024. Stale duplicate FR overlay removed, collection appearance fixed to p.66, and erroneous power-armor-frame metadata cleared.

candidates.name: Abomination
candidates.note: Authoritative 2024 replacement for the individual issue's p.22 Super Mutant. Complete collected-edition profile includes STR + Unarmed, Barbarian/immunities, and Inventory: Board, Scrapped and Damaged Armor, assorted human bones, Wealth 1.

candidates.name: Sally Jessup
candidates.note: The owner-approved 2024 collection p.67 supplies a complete derived profile: Core Mercenary with STR/END/AGI +2, HP 18, Defense 2 and 90 XP. Integrated as a distinct bilingual Actor; derived Initiative and melee bonus follow the changed attributes.

collectionReview.mapping: Individual printed/source pages 4–19 correspond to collection printed pages 46–61. From source p.20 onward the collection reflows and rewrites this section, so pp.20–23 are compared by heading/stat block rather than by a fixed page offset.

verifiedDifferences.difference: The observation test changes from PER + Speech to INT + Speech; narrative-only for compendium scope.
Wastelander changes to Carry Weight 210 lb, Melee Weapons 1, removes Energy Weapons 1, and adds 3+3 DC Shotgun Shells to Inventory.
Epoxy adds '(to a minimum of 0)' to the Repair difficulty reduction. Owner decision 2026-10-01 makes the 2024 collected edition authoritative; the floor is applied.
Skull Canyon Shot omits the individual issue's Lasting keyword. Owner decision 2026-10-01 makes the 2024 collected edition authoritative; Lasting is removed.
Living “mutant” worm rewords the AP benefit as 'Immediately gain 1 AP'; treated as wording-only in this checkpoint.

Butchery changes the yield name from 'Twinjaw Rattler meat' to 'Mutant Rattler meat'. The project had already approved reuse of the p.10 Mutant Rattler Meat identity for the structured yield, so that normalization remains applied.

Twin Heads is expanded to tie the two bites to a Major attack action and allow different targets; Death Rattle becomes once per battle and grants Stun to all attacks until end of turn; the poison-sack butchery branch is removed. Owner decision 2026-10-01 makes these 2024 mechanics authoritative and they are applied.
The collection adds a Core p.337 cross-reference for making Sergeant Jackson Notable; the optional named-Ranger modifiers remain scenario guidance rather than autonomous complete profiles.
The collection changes the NCR Trooper's LUC from 4 to 3 and adds 12+4 DC 10mm Rounds to Inventory. Owner decision 2026-10-01 makes the 2024 collected edition authoritative; both changes are applied.
Negotiation procedure and NCR-information prose are revised in the collection, but these are scenario procedures rather than reusable compendium documents.

The collection changes Homing Beacon discovery from a critical success to any AP spent during the investigation, changes the factory snooping test from AGI + Sneak to PER + Sneak, and adds a future-quest hook. These are scenario procedures/prose, not reusable compendium documents, so they are documented but not applied.

The collection makes Vexx truthful only if the PCs previously earned his trust (otherwise wary), adjusts Xarn/editorial wording, and revises hospital read-aloud prose. No complete reusable profile is defined, so no repository normalization is applied.

The collection revises the failed snake-warning result from 'surprised' to 'unaware' and explicitly points to the Core Rulebook Sneak Attack rule; this is encounter procedure only. The existing p.12 Twinjaw Rattler identity and butchery remain unchanged.

The collection clarifies the infiltration alternatives (including difficulty 4 for the Repair route), success wording, and the duration of recurring security-drone waves. These are scenario procedures rather than reusable compendium documents.
Security Drone, Protectron changes Energy DR from 4 (All) to 3 (All). Owner decision 2026-10-01 makes the 2024 collected edition authoritative; Energy DR 3 is applied.

The collection replaces the individual issue's Super Mutant with an Abomination profile using the same base SPECIAL/skills but only Unarmed Strike and Inventory: Board, Scrapped and Damaged Armor, assorted human bones, Wealth 1. Owner decision 2026-10-01 makes the 2024 Abomination authoritative; the 2023 Super Mutant is retained only as a historical source variant.
Secret Manipulation is reflowed into collection p.64 without defining a reusable profile for Mark Aurelius; no compendium normalization is applied.

The collection makes minor narrative/editorial fixes in the Act Three synopsis and Choosing Sides (including explicit Legion alignment wording and typo cleanup). No reusable structured document is affected.

The collection changes the Extended Test scaling: Breakthroughs Required stays 4 while Base Test Difficulty becomes 3 for more than four PCs, rather than increasing required breakthroughs to 5. It also rewrites the reinforcement basis and identifies Nok as a Major Skull Canyon Zetan NPC. These are scenario procedures/modifiers, not autonomous reusable profiles.

Skull Canyon Zetan changes from Mutated Reptile, 45 XP to Mutated Alien, 38 XP; Xarn and Nok are identified as Mighty Creatures with +2 Mind. Owner decision 2026-10-01 makes the 2024 collected edition authoritative; the base Zetan profile is corrected, while Xarn/Nok remain scenario-specific incomplete variant guidance.

Inertia Suppression Field retains the same 3 Physical / 3 Energy / 0 Radiation resistances, all locations, weight <1, cost 300 and rarity 4. Its collected-edition appearance is an identical reprint for the apparel identity.

The collection replaces the individual issue's reinforcement wording with breakthrough-count tables and adds a complete Sally Jessup profile derived from the Core Mercenary (+2 STR/END/AGI, HP 18, Defense 2, 90 XP). Owner decision 2026-10-01 makes the 2024 edition authoritative; Sally is integrated and the reinforcement scaling remains scenario procedure outside reusable compendium scope.

The collection makes narrative/editorial cleanup and revises Quest Rewards wording: the individual issue's 'another 20 Caps each in addition to the 15 already received' becomes 'another 20 Caps each in addition to the caps already received', and the final Secret Manipulation reward is clarified as '60 XP each'. These are scenario reward/bookkeeping rules rather than reusable compendium documents, so no repository normalization is applied.
